answers.ask: Should the stadium read as a modern broadcast arena, or something more stylised?
answers.answer: Use a modern broadcast-style soccer arena, matching the realistic match, VAR, replay, and team-kit setup.

answers.ask: How big is big - a club ground or a full national stadium bowl?
answers.answer: Make it a full national stadium bowl so it feels like a big professional soccer match venue.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D soccer map in a full national stadium bowl, styled as a modern broadcast arena for a realistic professional match. A regulation-scale grass pitch fills the center, with white boundary lines, center circle, penalty boxes, corner arcs, and full-size goals at opposite ends. Surround the field with a continuous perimeter, team benches and technical areas along the sidelines, and a large tiered seating bowl enclosing the pitch. Include a dedicated VAR review area near the sideline or stadium operations zone. Two teams occupy the field in distinct blue and red shirts, with individually numbered and named kits.
blob:
### Genre
The dominant genre is Sports: a regulation soccer match in a professional stadium. There is no secondary genre.

### Shape and preset
Use `field-bounded`, matching the Full Stadium preset. The prompt explicitly calls for a full national stadium bowl rather than a bare field, so retain the stadium enclosure, team sectors, and tiered audience seating.

### Config requirements
Use visible `spectator-bleachers` as a continuous, large tiered seating bowl around the pitch; visible `barrier-perimeter` as the stadium perimeter enclosing the field and containing play; and visible `spectator-zone` for the two team benches and technical areas along the sidelines. Use `npc-population` both visibly and invisibly: blue- and red-shirted team players stand on the pitch in individually numbered and named kits, with the associated character placements maintained as layout data. The dedicated VAR review area is visible geometry near a sideline operations zone, adjacent to but outside the field boundary.

### Layout components
Place a regulation-scale rectangular grass pitch at the center of the stadium, occupying the dominant central zone. Mark it clearly with white touchlines and goal lines, a center circle, halfway line, penalty boxes, goal areas, penalty spots, and four corner arcs. Put one full-size goal centered at each short end of the field. Run a continuous boundary and narrow sideline apron around all four sides. Position opposing team benches and technical areas along the long sidelines, facing the pitch, with the compact VAR review station near one sideline or stadium-operations edge. Surround this with a complete national-stadium seating bowl rising in broad tiers on every side. The pitch is flat, trimmed natural grass; the stadium structure is modern, clean, and broadcast-oriented. Frame the whole bowl in a high three-quarter isometric view, with the complete field readable and both goals visible.

### Render order
Use `isometric`: render the authoritative isometric stadium first, then derive the top-down plan. The field and seating geometry are straightforward and do not require validity-by-construction routing.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is huge, driven by the full national stadium bowl, complete regulation pitch, technical sidelines, and continuous audience enclosure. Theme is a realistic modern broadcast soccer arena: vivid striped grass, crisp white markings, neutral stadium concrete, and strong blue-versus-red team color contrast. Apply `tiered` because the seating bowl rises in stepped tiers without overhanging play surfaces.
